daily_whole_product_audit.scope: every repository surface, public UI element, runtime endpoint, integration, content, distribution channel, growth path and governance rule
daily_whole_product_audit.rule: No capability is considered live until implementation, reproducible test, deployment-surface verification and boundary evidence exist.
daily_whole_product_audit.user_visible_contract: Every user-visible control must have a reachable destination or explicit disabled state; labels, content, design, accessibility, language and purpose must match the actual behavior.
daily_whole_product_audit.regression_rule: A previously working capability must be rechecked after relevant changes; failures become P0/P1 work according to impact.
daily_whole_product_audit.growth_rule: Measure discovery, search visibility, referrals, repository visits, site visits, activation and retention with verified first-party evidence where available; never invent reach.
daily_whole_product_audit.execution_rule: The daily unified IMA loop must execute safe authorized fixes, verify them, record blockers and improve its own audit coverage.
